text: Setting clear project goals is essential for success. One useful method is using SMART goals, which means goals that are Specific, Measurable, Achievable, Relevant, and Time-bound. Breaking a project into milestones helps you track progress and stay motivated along the way. Deliverables are the concrete results you promise to produce, such as reports or products. It is also important to align goals with stakeholders, including team members, clients, and managers. When everyone agrees on the objectives, the project runs more smoothly and avoids confusion. Good planning at the start saves time and effort later.
